message.reasoning_content:
The watch is a Jaeger-LeCoultre Master Ultra Thin Moon or Master Control with moonphase and date. Looking at the dial: silver/white dial, applied triangular/baton indices, dauphine hands, small seconds subdial at 6 with moonphase aperture and date ring around it with Arabic numerals 1,3,5,...31 pointing outward with a small pointer. Text "AUTOMATIQUE" beneath the moonphase. "SWISS MADE" at bottom.

This is the Jaeger-LeCoultre Master Ultra Thin Moon 39mm — reference 1368420 (steel, silver dial). Actually the Master Ultra Thin Moon 39 ref Q1368420 is stainless steel with silver dial and alligator strap. Or the newer Master Ultra Thin Moon 39 in steel: Q1368430? Let me recall.

JLC Master Ultra Thin Moon 39mm stainless steel: Q1368420 (silver dial, black alligator). Actually 1368420 is steel with silver dial. There is also 1362520 (rose gold). The newer generation (2023?) Master Ultra Thin Moon 39 reference Q1368430? Hmm.

The Master Ultra Thin Moon 39 ref 1368420 — "Q1368420". JLC references typically given with "Q" prefix, e.g., Q1368420. However the official format often written as 136.84.20 or Q1368420.

The dial here shows date ring with numbers around the moonphase, "AUTOMATIQUE". That matches Master Ultra Thin Moon (1368420). The Master Control also has date... Actually Master Control Calendar differs.

The dial indices: The Master Ultra Thin Moon has applied indices with dauphine hands, and the subdial at 6 with moonphase and date pointer. Yes.

So reference: Q1368420 (steel, silvered dial, black alligator strap). Confidence moderate.

Movement: automatic (AUTOMATIQUE), caliber 925/1. Case material: stainless steel. Bracelet: leather (alligator).

Let me finalize.
